messages:
Maya: Heads-up — paging started from incident-bot for elevated 5xxs hitting /v1/generate in eu-west-1 around 08:02 UTC. Not full outage but customer-facing error rate up (~3% vs baseline 0.1%).
Tom: seeing it too, p95 latency also drifting up for the same route.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2338 — Elevated 5xxs on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Pager notified oncall rotation.
Maya: quick context: Dedicated pools in eu-west are under higher load after a batch of long-context jobs started at 07:40. Looks like contention on kv-cache + sporadic kernel OOMs (from logs).
Leah: can we triage current prim/sec? I'm primary for night shift but Aaron is covering for first 2 hours.
Aaron: I'm secondary, taking the bridge. Maya — can you drop runbook link?
Maya: runbook-bot: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-degradation — follow "Degraded KV cache -> restore" steps.
Maya: TL;DR steps I started: 1) isolate affected instances by tag (eu-west-gen-1) 2) scale up cache nodes 3) roll traffic to warm fallback model variant.
Tom: Suggestion: temporarily raise the p95 alert threshold for that route from 180ms -> 250ms to reduce noise during mitigation. Also add a suppression window for the p99 pager for 30m while we finish scaling. Thoughts?
Leah: That seems reasonable if we can confirm customer impact stability. Which customers are hitting that route?
Maya: quick customer impact check: top callers in last 30m: acme-inc, notes.ai, and two internal test keys. Acme saw 1-2 failing requests per 1000 — degraded but not total outage.
Aaron: OK — operationally I'll be primary for the bridge. I'll apply the suppression and track errors.
Tom: I'll propose the exact alert tweak:
```
alerts.routes.v1_generate.p95_threshold = 250
alerts.routes.v1_generate.p99_pager = disabled for 30m (suppression_id: temp-eu-warmup-2338)
```
Tom: Also set a complementary SLO note: temporarily annotate the SLO dashboard that we have an in-progress mitigation for eu-west-1 on 5xx spike.
Maya: noted. I'm going to scale the dedicated pool by +2 nodes now and warm the fallback variant.
runbook-bot: Action logged: scale_pool eu-west-gen-1 +2 by Maya at 08:12 UTC.
Leah: If scaling doesn't reduce 5xxs in 10m, plan B is to reroute non-enterprise traffic to eu-central and keep enterprise pinned. Need rollout command ready.
Aaron: I'll prepare the rollout command and runbook excerpt in case.
Maya: Update: scaled +2, warming fallback. KV cache eviction errors dropping in logs. 5xx rate went from 3.1% -> 1.2% in last 3m.
Tom: I'm applying the temporary alert threshold change now. Doing it from console — will paste audit link once done.
Tom: audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/2338/alert-change — changed p95 to 250ms and enabled 30m suppression for p99 pager.
Leah: Good. Keep suppression short and watch for regression after scale completes. Also record the decision in the incident timeline for SLAs.
Maya: customer impact note added to incident: "Partial errors, no major data loss, degraded latency; enterprise customers OK, some small volume affected".
Aaron: Bridge summary for next handoff: primary=Aaron (until 10:00 UTC), secondary=Maya, suppression temp-eu-warmup-2338 ends at 08:42 UTC, rollback plan: revert p95 and remove suppression once error rate <0.2% for 15m.
Leah: Perfect. I'm tagging oncall-manager for awareness. @oncall-manager FYI — temporary SLO/alert adjustment for eu-west while we finish mitigation.
oncall-bot: @oncall-manager added to INC-2338.
Maya: follow-up: after warm fallback and cache scale, 5xx down to 0.25% and p95 back ~170ms. Rolling back suppression in 5m and restoring thresholds to baseline.
Tom: rolling thresholds back now. audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/2338/alert-rollback
Maya: Confirming rollback complete. No further paging. Leaving a quick postmortem note: cause = cache contention from long-context batch jobs; mitigation = scale + fallback variant + short suppression. Recommend adding auto-scale trigger when hot prefix activity > X.
Aaron: I'll include that in the SLO runbook and update the alerting playbook to include a pre-approved 30m suppression for similar situations.
Leah: Thanks team. Closing bridge; next handoff Aaron -> night team at 10:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
